steps.en: Install gdb 7.3+ and pyrasite, and allow ptrace on the host
steps.zh: 装好 gdb 7.3+ 和 pyrasite，并在主机上放开 ptrace

steps.en: Pick a bundled payload (thread stacks, memory dump…) or write your own .py file
steps.zh: 挑一个自带载荷（线程栈、内存统计……）或自己写个 .py 文件

steps.en: Run it against the live PID, asking for the output on your own terminal
steps.zh: 对活进程的 PID 执行，并要求把输出送回你的终端

steps.en: Attaches gdb to the PID and takes the interpreter lock
steps.zh: 用 gdb 附着到该 PID，拿到解释器锁

steps.en: Makes the target's interpreter exec your file, with full access to its modules and objects
steps.zh: 让目标解释器 exec 你的文件，可直接访问它的模块和对象

steps.en: Releases the lock and detaches; the process keeps running
steps.zh: 还锁并脱离，进程继续运行

value.en: See inside a stuck or leaking Python process — its thread stacks, its objects — without restarting it or having instrumented it in advance
value.zh: 不重启、也不用事先埋点，就能看到卡住或漏内存的 Python 进程内部的线程栈和对象
